en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions silently losing all host config (settings, skills, plugins, MCP servers) when the host config directory exceeds 64 MiB; added `--host-config-snapshot disk|memory`
zh: 修复当主机配置目录超过 64 MiB 时，自托管运行器 session 静默丢失所有主机配置（设置、skills、plugins、MCP servers）的问题；新增 `--host-config-snapshot disk|memory`
